# Veteran Drywall LLC

> USMC veteran-owned drywall contractor based in North Port, Florida (34286), serving Sarasota and Charlotte counties: North Port, Port Charlotte, Venice, Sarasota, Englewood and Punta Gorda. Drywall repair, texture matching, water and storm damage repair, ceiling repair, popcorn ceiling removal, new drywall and remodel finishing, stucco repair, painting and trim. Free written estimates.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Veteran Drywall LLC (brand: Veteran Drywall)
- Owner: Steven McPherson, U.S. Marine Corps veteran (10+ years of service, four overseas deployments)
- Crew: Steven, Mike and Rick
- Florida contractor license: SCC131152687 (verify at https://www.myfloridalicense.com/wl11.asp)
- Phone: (941) 527-5924 (main, call or text) · (941) 929-3545 (alternate)
- Email: info@veteransdrywall.net
- Address: 5390 Halkett Ter, North Port, FL 34286
- Website: https://veteransdrywall.net
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61557745545101
- Estimates: free; most estimates returned within one business day; photos accepted through the online form
- Not to be confused with similarly named businesses using "veterandrywall" domains.

## Services
- [Drywall repair](https://veteransdrywall.net/drywall-repair/): holes, cracks, nail pops, dented corner bead, re-pipe patches
- [Texture matching](https://veteransdrywall.net/texture-matching/): knockdown, orange peel, skip trowel, popcorn, smooth Level 5, stucco
- [Water & storm damage repair](https://veteransdrywall.net/water-damage-drywall-repair/): leaks, AC overflows, flood cuts, hurricane damage (after the area is dry; no mold remediation)
- [Ceiling repair](https://veteransdrywall.net/ceiling-repair/): cracks, sagging, stains, nail pops
- [Popcorn ceiling removal](https://veteransdrywall.net/popcorn-ceiling-removal/): scrape and refinish; pre-mid-1980s homes should test for asbestos first
- [New drywall & remodels](https://veteransdrywall.net/new-construction-drywall/): hang, tape, finish; Level 4–5
- [Stucco repair](https://veteransdrywall.net/stucco-repair/)
- [Painting, carpentry & trim](https://veteransdrywall.net/painting-trim/)
- [Property manager / realtor punch lists](https://veteransdrywall.net/property-managers/)
